notes: family: set-collection. Score track point values depend on player count (neutral markers cover spaces) and the order markers were placed, so each track total is entered directly. Game ends at end of the round where a player gets the 4th Rat on the Launchpad, or after one extra round once a player places an 8th Score marker (max 10 markers). Variable-setup Score tracks and solo (vs. Greg: total your points vs. his) not modelled. Fixed Score tile values and other Bottle Cap values are printed on components.
